crop: Cultivated Olea europaea subsp. europaea, table/oil cultivars
selection: Primary studies selected without inspecting v3 scores. Source-derived coordinates only; city centroids and conflicting coordinates excluded.
interpretation: Field evidence checks climate compatibility and whether hazards are flagged. Repeated fruiting is not a validated probability of reliable annual economic harvest.

protocol.purpose: Independent orchard compatibility checks of a climate screen, not fitted yield or reliability probability.
protocol.rule_freeze_mean: Keep existing v2.1 annual extreme minimum response curve. Extend globally using annual TNn-derived 1991-2020 mean, retain PRISM where available as local higher-resolution supplemental mean.
protocol.rule_freeze_tail: Display 1991-2025 coldest annual TNn and fraction of annual minima <= -7, -10 and -12.2 C. Policy cap: observed <= -12.2 C at least once -> max59; <= -10C in >=20% years -> max39; <=-7C in >=20% years -> max79. These are explicit conservative risk-policy choices, not calibrated mortality probabilities.
protocol.core_temperature_wetness: Freeze v2.1 non-freeze curves before sampling the orchard evidence. Do not tune to evaluation scores.
protocol.eligibility: Use all independently gathered primary orchard studies with exact/explicit location precision and field production/damage evidence. Regional context without orchard coordinates is excluded from point metrics.
protocol.irrigation: Use documented regime. If unknown, report both and classify only if both satisfy the relevant criterion.
protocol.production_metric: Multi-year measured fruit/oil production (>=3 years) should be compatible with >=40 in the corresponding documented water regime. >=80 is not required for humid managed groves. Cultivar failures remain separate.
protocol.failure_metric: Documented repeated climate-related nonflowering or damaging freezes should not be called favorable (score<80). Alternate bearing alone is not a climate-negative label.
protocol.challenge_metric: Short trials, cultivar-conditional fruiting, damage+recovery and location ambiguity are reported separately and not promoted into strong reliable-yield labels.
protocol.split: All independently collected sites are evaluation-only in this release. Existing curated pins and v2.1 checks are prior-used contextual controls, not independent validation.
protocol.reporting: Publish every eligible result, including contradictions, sample counts by class and geographic clustering; do not claim global accuracy, specificity without negatives, or reliable annual harvest probability.

sites.name: Pedro Abad cultivar and density trials, Cordoba, Spain
sites.management: Drip 2000m3/ha/year, sometimes extended to October.
sites.observations: Twelve annual harvested crops after planting in 2000. Mean fruit yield 13.1t/ha/year for Arbequina and 14.2 for Arbosana; marked losses after freezes and flowering heat.
sites.freezeEvidence: Trees damaged by winter 2004-2005 temperatures below -9C and 2011-2012 below -6C; winter waterlogging and >30C bloom heat also recorded.

sites.name: INIA Las Brujas, Uruguay
sites.coordinateProvenance: Paper reports station coordinate 34°40′S 56°20′W.
sites.management: Drip irrigation 100% ETc; raised beds; 4–6 preventive/disease-control sprays per season.
sites.observations: Average fruit yield: Arbequina 11.1, Picual 11.3 t/ha/year. Pronounced alternate bearing; 2013 near-zero except Barnea. All cultivar ABI values above 0.58.
sites.reliabilityQualifier: Eight-year production demonstrates feasibility with irrigation and fungicides; does not demonstrate a harvest every year.

sites.observations: Average fruit yield Arbequina and Picual each 7.9 t/ha/year; Frantoio 2.3. High interannual variability.
sites.reliabilityQualifier: Humid managed production, with cultivar effects and alternate bearing; not an annual-yield guarantee.

sites.name: Tierras Blancas, San Felipe, Chile
sites.coordinateProvenance: Paper reports orchard coordinate 32°47′S 70°42′W, altitude 800 m.
sites.management: Micro-sprinkler control 100% ETc and deficit treatments; mature 8-year-old table-olive orchard; pollinizers 15%.
sites.observations: Fruit loads and harvest yields measured for three seasons, 1998–99 through 2000–01. 1999–2000 was the high-crop year; other two were low-crop years. Continuous deficit reduced high-year fruit load.
sites.reliabilityQualifier: Repeated table-olive production with ordinary alternate bearing, conditional on irrigation.
